en: Finally, we're here...
So where is this guy of yours?
Somewhere outside the city, I think. I'm not really sure.
Outside the city... whatever, let's go look first and worry later.
This is the Magic Institute. No unauthorized persons.
Halt!!
Hello! We've come to borrow the magic detector. There's a kind of key in this underground world..... it can open the Cross Entry... and this gate is a matter of.....
What? The Cross Entry? Keys? The magic detector? Sorry, this isn't a place for little girls' fairy tales. Run along home.
I'm not a little girl! I'm a Junior Swordsman!!!
I can't be bothered with you. Clear off!!!
Why don't you just tell them you're the prince?
To avoid unnecessary trouble.
I think this is MORE trouble!
Look, I didn't come out here just to keep you company. I've got a pile of investigating to do, and I can't do it if my cover's blown.
Phew... fine... fine, then. Let's go rest at the inn and work out a plan after a good night's sleep.
Still not gone??
What are you two doing here again?
Nothing. Just passing by.
Ha ha! No guard, just like I thought! Quick, use your magic and open this lock!
You~ you what... Just open it!
Fine, we're taking it, but why go in the front door?
Are you opening it or not?
Okay, okay, okay, right away, right away...
I can't open it.
It's not locked with magic. It's a really complicated mechanism.
Then blast it open with a fireball.
You want to wake up the whole city?
Ohh... so the people here are pretty smart. Mages can't get in, and for anyone else, breaking in is suicide... so then...
I'll do it.
Still talking, Eluna pulls out her hairpin and starts picking the lock.
Done. In we go.
Were you really raised in Kabras Temple? Knowing stuff like this...
Who cares, as long as it works. Let's go find out where that magic detector is.
So boring... this city is so boring...
Maybe next time I'll go hang around Kabras.
It's strange... what am I even living in this world for? There's no particular reason...
But I don't want to die, either. Hmm, it's really strange.
The teleport circles in town can be started with a Homeward scroll. That's the Magic Institute's doing.
Someday I'm going to work at the Magic Institute too.
Hello, is anyone home?
I'm not in!
Excuse me, would you be Locke Reiter, the former Historian? I have a few questions I'd like to ask.
Get in!
Let's wait until we've collected the keys before asking him anything, or he'll just throw us out again.
Inn
That night...
Get up!!
Wha... what is it...?
Duh, we're going to borrow the magic detector!
Oh, the magic detector...
Wait!! Didn't they say they won't lend it to us?
So if they won't lend it, we can't go take it ourselves?
What? We can't do that!
Why not? Quit whining! Move it!
Zzz... zzz...
The innkeeper is fast asleep.
Locke Reiter's House
Hello, Master Historian.
Whatever it is, out with it!
Okay. We came to ask about the Cross Entry. Would you tell us what you know about it?
So you want to know where the Cross Entry is?
Yes.
Then... get out!
Wh-what?
I'll give you five seconds to leave this house.
Um, actually, I'm from the capital. I'm with the palace...
Oh? In that case...
I'll give you three seconds. Vanish!!
Get out, now!!
Wait. Come back.
You...
The former Historian points at Eluna's right hand.
Where did you get this?
I've had it ever since Kabras Temple took me in.
The former Historian takes Eluna's right hand and studies it closely for thirty seconds.
Very well. I'll tell you how to open the Cross Entry.
So if I collect one key from every city in Okaros except Kabras, I can open that gate?
Correct.
So where is that gate?
You don't need to know that until you've found all the keys.
Okay, then we'll come straight to you once we have them. Delat, let's go.
Wait, aren't we forgetting something? Um... where are those keys?
No comment.
Leave that part to me.
Delat raises an eyebrow at Eluna as they leave the former Historian's house.
You really know where those keys are?
How can you be so dense? Just because he said "key", it has to be an ordinary key? They're magic items, obviously. Enhanced lightstone or something.
And if they really are ordinary keys?
Even if they are, something that important is bound to be guarded by powerful magic. So you just find where the magic anomalies are!
Ohhh~~
Got it? Then let's go.
But you seem to have missed something.
Did I ever say I could detect magic anomalies?
And even if I could, something that important would have anti-detection magic on it, right?
...So what do we do?
Shouldn't I be the one asking that?
Let's go back and ask the former Historian.
He'll say "You've got ten seconds to get out."
Neither has anything to say. Ten minutes pass.
Ha ha, I've got it! Even if you can't, Snowblade is bound to have a device for that, right? And a strong enough one, I bet!
A magic detector? Sure, they have one, but how are we supposed to borrow it?
Never mind all that. Let's go try first.
My father... is it true that he...
Yes, it's true. That's exactly why I resigned my post.
Wait, if you knew the truth back then, why didn't you stop him!
Your father had only just appointed me. And how could I stop him? Tell the other cities? Who would believe me?
So you resigned.
Exactly.
...Ha ha ha, that's a great joke! It almost sounds real.
Delat...
How many keys do you have now?
Three.
Good. Then I'll tell you where the last key is. Take this.
Go to Kabras Graveyard and find a gravestone that moves. Open it with this. Inside, besides the fourth key, there is also...
Okay, let's go.
Go on, then.
Tell me, now!!! Is there really nobody at all on the surface?!! Is it really true!!
...I don't really know why myself, but according to the records, it's barren up there.
I don't believe it! Those books of yours must be wrong!
Eluna...
Tell me where the Cross Entry is, now! I'll go up and see for myself!
Very well... the Cross Entry... lies right beneath Kabras palace.
Magic Institute Hall
What does a magic detector look like?
Probably some kind of giant magic circle.
Then what's this in front of us?
Your luck leaves me speechless... they actually built the thing right in the main hall...
Hurry up. Start looking.
Okay...
Found anything?
Nope. The circle must not be strong enough.
Even this one can't do it? Fine, then I'll soup it up.
You know how?
Relax. I can't cast spells, but I know magic circles inside out. I've read more than half the palace library, after all. Now let's go find materials. You're helping.
Half an hour later...
Hey... are you trying to blow the Magic Institute sky-high? A whole chain of element-boost stones, plus a space-weakening device...
Relax, it'll be fine. It's all set up. Get over here and look.
Well?
I think I should recommend you to the palace's Institute...
This is way too clear. I can see every magic anomaly in the whole country...
Then hurry up and write down every anomaly!
Mmm...
Done.
Why so many?
Some of it is stuff I need to look into.
Let me see, hmm... eight o'clock... half an hour early... ten minutes... hmm, if I've got it right, someone will be here in two minutes. Run!
Two minutes? The exit's way over there!! Waah...
Eluna drags Delat off at a full sprint.
Haah... hah... phew...
Did you have to run that fast? You think everyone's like you?!
Quit whining. Did the magic detector show you where the keys are?
Phew... there are... three places... where first?
Three? I'd have thought there'd be four keys.
Thing is, besides Kabras there are only three cities.
Hmm...
Then let's grab Snowblade's first. Where is it?
The bottom level of the Magic Institute.
Then... RUN!!!
Waaah!!!!
Magic Institute: Restricted Area
Phew... we're finally in.
Is this the room?
I think so? The Magic Institute's restricted area...
And it isn't even locked? Whatever, let's go in.
Looks like a huge maze...?
Then what are you standing around gawking for?! Move it! Who knows how far we've got to go?
Pi
You don't have that.
Heh heh, so someone has finally found this place? Ah, you wear that bracelet. No wonder you got through the spell I laid.
Oh, the spell that keeps people from finding the way out? No wonder there's no lock.
Now then, show me your strength. Show me whether you are able to seek the truth.
Not bad. Very well, this key of mine is yours.
This thing is the key?
That guy wasn't so bad, sending us back outside like that. Okay, on to the next city.
Mm.
Huh? Hey, why didn't you just find the Cross Entry itself? Wouldn't that save us all this trouble?
I looked carefully. Every strong magic reaction was where I expected: the three cities, the palace, a few lightstone mines, these research sites. Not one extra, and no gate.
Oh? So is it just an ordinary door? Or is the magic guarding it too strong...
Come on, even if you knew where it was, what good would it do? You can't open it anyway.
True. Let's just collect the keys first.
Ah, why won't this chest open?
Did Mom send you?... Fine... I'll come home in a bit.
We've got nothing here except what we've got.
Have a look and pick what you like.
Had a bit too much to drink just now... my head's spinning...
Huh? Did you come all this way to learn my secret technique?
All right, I'll teach you. I doubt I'll ever use it again anyway.
I've got nothing left to teach you.
There's a problem I've been stuck on for ages. Could you help me out?
There are two numbers, each less than ten. Call them X and Y.
2 to the power X, times 9 to the power Y, equals 2 times X times 9 times Y.
So what are X and Y?
Hmm, that doesn't seem right...
Ah! That's it, exactly! Thank you so much!
Hmm... let's see... oh, I know! Please take this. I insist.
Thanks so much for your help!
Oh, and this time let me teach you something too!
My son went outside the city and still hasn't come back. Could you go check on him for me?
Then I'll leave it to you.
Oh, so that's what happened. Thank you so much.
Oh, and I've no use for these anymore. Please, take them.
Do drop by again.
Being stuck at home all day is so boring!
